title: AI × Chem 每日精选
subtitle: 预印本、方法、数据集与实验验证的每日精选。
method: 公开来源采集、历史去重、规则筛选与模型审阅
method_note: 系统保存当日公开元数据，与历史日报核验后排除已报道事件；论文新版本、新修订及不同软件发布等可核实更新仍可入选，随后由指定模型阅读全文摘要并完成精选。

items.title: Hit-Triage Pretrained Transformer (Hit-TPT), an Interaction-Agnostic Graph-Transformer for Post-docking Enrichment
items.abstract_or_text: Computational docking-based virtual screening is widely used to identify hit compounds in earlystage drug discovery. However, current docking methods still suffer from high false-positive rates, often resulting in no hits identified in campaigns against novel targets. For instance, in the first several CACHE challenges, the hit rate was consistently below 1%. This underscores the need for more selective and reliable triage methods. Here we present the Hit-Triage Pretrained Transformer (Hit-TPT), a graph neural network operating on protein-ligand interaction graphs to recognize true protein binders from decoys. Rooted in molecular recognition, Hit-TPT treats molecular complexes as 3D physical entities. It utilizes an interaction-agnostic graph transformer architecture combined with physics-informed atom features to reflect underlying chemical relationships while employing a novel 3D-positional encodings to represents the geometric context of each atom. The model was developed and evaluated using the DUD-E dataset, which comprises 102 targets with known actives and property matched decoys. To ensure rigorous validation, the model was trained on 77 targets and evaluated on a strictly held out test set of the remaining 25 targets. Hit-TPT achieved a mean Enrichment Factor in the top 1% of best-ranked ligands (EF1%) of 42 across these 25 test targets, substantially outperforming benchmarked conventional and ML-based methods. Crucially, we demonstrated that this high performance is not a dataset related artifact. Many previous machine learning models inadvertently function as ligand-only classifiers because training datasets rarely feature the same ligand across multiple targets with varying affinities. To prove Hit-TPT overcomes this limitation and learns genuine intermolecular interaction patterns rather than memorizing ligand scaffolds, we conducted a cross-target prediction analysis. This showed that Hit-TPT assigns high binding-probability scores to an active ligand exclusively when evaluated against its native target, confirming that the network successfully avoids ligand bias. Our results demonstrate that this physics-oriented architecture can markedly reduce false positives in virtual screening, offering a practical and generalizable approach to improve hit-finding efficiency by prioritizing compounds with genuine, target specific activity.
items.summary_zh: Hit-TPT 以蛋白–配体相互作用图为输入，结合物理信息原子特征与 3D 位置编码，用于对接后筛选的真结合物优先级排序；在 DUD-E 的 77/25 靶标严格划分中报告 EF1%=42，并通过跨靶标分析检验其是否学习到真实相互作用。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 该工作直接针对虚拟筛选的高假阳性问题，并将跨靶标检验纳入模型评估，有助于识别仅凭配体骨架取巧的模型。证据仍来自 DUD-E 基准，尚需在前瞻性筛选和实验命中验证中确认可迁移性。
items.abstract_zh: 基于计算对接的虚拟筛选广泛用于早期药物发现中的命中化合物鉴定。然而，现有对接方法仍面临较高假阳性率，在针对新靶标的筛选中常常无法获得命中物。例如，在最初数届 CACHE 挑战中，命中率始终低于 1%。这凸显出对更具选择性且更可靠的筛选方法的需求。本文提出 Hit-Triage Pretrained Transformer（Hit-TPT），这是一种作用于蛋白–配体相互作用图的图神经网络，用于从诱饵分子中识别真正的蛋白结合物。Hit-TPT 植根于分子识别，将分子复合物视为三维物理实体。它采用不预设相互作用类型的图 Transformer 架构，结合物理信息原子特征以反映潜在化学关系，并采用新型 3D 位置编码来表征每个原子的几何环境。该模型使用 DUD-E 数据集开发和评估；该数据集包含 102 个具有已知活性物和性质匹配诱饵分子的靶标。为确保严格验证，模型在 77 个靶标上训练，并在其余 25 个靶标构成的严格留出测试集上评估。Hit-TPT 在这 25 个测试靶标上取得平均前 1% 最佳排序配体富集因子（EF1%）42，显著优于纳入比较的传统方法和机器学习方法。关键在于，我们证明这一高性能并非由数据集造成的假象。许多既有机器学习模型会无意中充当仅依赖配体的分类器，因为训练数据集很少包含同一配体在不同靶标上具有不同亲和力的情形。为证明 Hit-TPT 克服了这一局限，并且学习到真实的分子间相互作用模式而非记忆配体骨架，我们进行了跨靶标预测分析。结果显示，只有当活性配体针对其天然靶标进行评估时，Hit-TPT 才赋予其高结合概率分数，证实该网络成功避免了配体偏倚。结果表明，这一面向物理的架构可显著减少虚拟筛选中的假阳性，通过优先选择具有真实靶标特异性活性的化合物，为提高命中发现效率提供实用且可泛化的方法。
items.author_line: Hamza Hentabli, Akhila Mettu, Xiaowen Wang, Dmitri Kireev

items.title: A Hierarchical Synergistic Deep Learning Framework Integrating Composition, Structure, and Ionic Transport for Solid-State Electrolyte Discovery
items.abstract_or_text: Inorganic solid-state electrolytes must combine high room-temperature ionic conductivity, a wide electrochemical window, excellent electronic insulation, and favorable mechanical compliance. Single models struggle to support reliable multi-objective screening across vast chemical spaces because of training-data distribution mismatch, cross-property dataset heterogeneity, and scarce kinetic transport data. To overcome these limitations, we develop a hierarchical synergistic deep-learning framework that sequentially coordinates efficiency, accuracy, and reliability through four complementary modules. The in-house-developed L-G-DCNN and a multi-fidelity implementation built on DenseGNN serve as compositional and structural experts for thermodynamic coarse screening and multi-property evaluation, respectively; MatterSim and system-specific DeePMD models provide transport pre-assessment and kinetic validation. Systematic benchmarks show that each module outperforms mainstream counterparts in its task, while retrospective validation establishes dual closed-loop verification of module-level accuracy and end-to-end workflow reliability. Applied to 30,364,908 Alex/ICSD-derived candidates, the framework identifies 97 high-performance candidates with room-temperature ionic conductivities of 0.109--59.0 mS/cm, including 94 halides, one borohydride, and two oxides. Consistency with independent experimental data confirms that 76 of the 94 halides fall within reported high-conductivity structural regions. Analysis reveals that Li^{+} jump-network connectivity, rather than the number of geometric Li sites, is the core determinant of room-temperature ionic conductivity. Li-defect engineering effectively enhances oxide transport, whereas the inherent rigidity of the O^{2-} framework suggests a potential upper limit on oxide electrolyte performance.
items.summary_zh: 该研究构建由组成、结构和离子输运模块协同的深度学习筛选流程，在 30,364,908 个 Alex/ICSD 候选中识别 97 种高性能固态电解质，并以独立实验数据核对卤化物候选的高电导结构区域。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 工作把热力学、多性质预测与动力学输运连接到同一筛选流程，并给出大规模候选空间和独立实验一致性证据，对固态电解质发现具有较强参考价值。其模块化结果仍主要是回顾性验证，具体候选的可合成性、界面稳定性及实测性能仍需逐一检验。
items.abstract_zh: 无机固态电解质必须同时具备高室温离子电导率、宽电化学窗口、优异电子绝缘性和良好机械顺应性。由于训练数据分布失配、跨性质数据集异质性以及动力学输运数据稀缺，单一模型难以在广阔化学空间中支持可靠的多目标筛选。为克服这些限制，我们开发了一个分级协同深度学习框架，通过四个互补模块依次协调效率、准确性和可靠性。自主开发的 L-G-DCNN 以及基于 DenseGNN 的多保真实现分别作为组成和结构专家，用于热力学粗筛和多性质评估；MatterSim 与体系特异的 DeePMD 模型则提供输运预评估和动力学验证。系统基准测试显示，每个模块在其任务上均优于主流对照方法；回顾性验证则建立了模块准确性与端到端流程可靠性的双重闭环验证。该框架应用于 30,364,908 个源自 Alex/ICSD 的候选，识别出 97 个高性能候选，其室温离子电导率为 0.109--59.0 mS/cm，包括 94 种卤化物、1 种硼氢化物和 2 种氧化物。与独立实验数据的一致性证实，94 种卤化物中有 76 种位于已报道的高电导结构区域内。分析表明，Li^{+} 跳迁网络连通性而非几何 Li 位点数目，是决定室温离子电导率的核心因素。Li 缺陷工程可有效增强氧化物输运，而 O^{2-} 骨架固有的刚性提示氧化物电解质性能可能存在上限。
items.author_line: Hongwei Du, Dingyang Lv, Baole Wei, Yongheng Li, Feng Yu, Ziheng Lu, Siqi Shi, Hong Wang

items.title: Explain and Go Beyond with Surfacia: A Surface-Descriptor based Workflow for Interpretable Molecular Machine Learning
items.abstract_or_text: Machine-learning models are widely used in chemistry, yet black-box predictions are often difficult to translate into chemically actionable descriptor-response rules or candidate-prioritization decisions. We present Surfacia, an automated workflow that transforms molecular structures and target values into wavefunction-derived surface descriptors, compact interpretable models, SHAP-based chemical interpretation, and visualization. The Surfacia descriptor system contains two complementary components: whole-molecule physical descriptors, which summarize geometry, orbital properties, and statistics of real-space molecular-surface functions, including electrostatic potential (ESP), average local ionization energy (ALIE), and local electron attachment energy (LEAE); and multi-scale quantitative surface analysis (MQSA) descriptors, which reorganize these surface properties around chemically meaningful units. We evaluated Surfacia on three case studies: sulfur-containing modifiers in carbon dioxide reduction reaction (CO2RR), a homologous organocatalyst series, and the Estimated SOLubility (ESOL) benchmark. The Results and Discussion are organized in two layers. First, compact selected Surfacia models are interpreted as chemically readable regression models. Second, a separate frontier-conditioned acquisition analysis asks whether the same sparse descriptor-SHAP landscape can support high-value candidate prioritization under a limited experimental budget. This second layer formalizes the chemist's go-beyond question as a sequential discovery problem: given only the current labeled set and a hidden frontier candidate pool, which acquisition rule can reach the true top-1 candidate with the lowest experimental cost? The comparison shows that descriptor-space novelty is the most stable region-entry signal, while SHAP-derived landscape information provides an interpretable way to order candidates within or around those novel regions. Thus, Surfacia connects mechanistically legible descriptor-response interpretation with a practical framework for discovery-oriented candidate selection, without requiring the SHAP-cliff variant to be universally superior to all novelty or diversity baselines.
items.summary_zh: Surfacia 将波函数导出的分子表面描述符、紧凑模型、SHAP 解释和候选可视化整合为自动流程，并在 CO2RR 改性剂、有机催化剂系列及 ESOL 上考察可解释预测和有限实验预算下的候选优先级选择。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 它尝试把机器学习预测转化为可读的化学描述符–响应关系，并将解释性与序贯发现问题联系起来。结果表明新颖性信号较稳定，但 SHAP 信息并未在所有基线比较中普遍占优，且案例数有限。
items.abstract_zh: 机器学习模型已广泛用于化学，但黑箱预测往往难以转化为可付诸化学行动的描述符–响应规则或候选优先级决策。我们提出 Surfacia，这是一套自动化流程，可将分子结构和目标值转化为波函数导出的表面描述符、紧凑的可解释模型、基于 SHAP 的化学解释和可视化。Surfacia 描述符体系包含两个互补组成部分：全分子物理描述符，用于概括几何、轨道性质和实空间分子表面函数的统计特征，包括静电势（ESP）、平均局域电离能（ALIE）和局域电子附着能（LEAE）；以及多尺度定量表面分析（MQSA）描述符，用于围绕具有化学意义的单元重组这些表面性质。我们在三个案例研究中评估 Surfacia：二氧化碳还原反应（CO2RR）中的含硫改性剂、一个同系有机催化剂系列和 Estimated SOLubility（ESOL）基准。结果与讨论由两部分组成。第一部分，将紧凑的精选 Surfacia 模型解释为在化学上可读的回归模型。第二部分是独立的前沿条件获取分析，考察同一稀疏描述符–SHAP 图景能否在有限实验预算下支持高价值候选的优先级选择。这一部分将化学家“超越现有结果”的问题形式化为一个序贯发现问题：仅给定当前带标签集合和隐藏的前沿候选池，哪一种获取规则能以最低实验成本找到真实的 top-1 候选？比较显示，描述符空间新颖性是最稳定的区域进入信号，而 SHAP 导出的图景信息提供了一种可解释方式，用于在这些新区域内或其附近排列候选。因此，Surfacia 将机制上可理解的描述符–响应解释与面向发现的候选选择实用框架联系起来，并不要求 SHAP-cliff 变体在所有情况下都优于全部新颖性或多样性基线。
items.author_line: Yuming Su, Yangtao Chen, Yiheng Dai, Cheng Wang

items.title: A General-Purpose Molecular Foundation Model Transfers Across Diverse Olfactory Tasks
items.abstract_or_text: Foundation models have transformed molecular property prediction, yet it remains unclear whether a molecular foundation model, fine-tuned on a single canonical olfactory prediction task, can learn representations that transfer across diverse machine olfaction problems. We investigate this question by fine-tuning Uni-Mol2 on the GS-LF benchmark for multi-label odor descriptor prediction and evaluating the resulting model, without additional deep-learning training, on four complementary downstream settings: cross-dataset odor descriptor prediction, odorous-versus-odorless classification, enantiomer evaluation, and odor mixture discriminability. The fine-tuned model matches or exceeds the performance of the state-of-the-art olfaction-specific baseline on the primary GS-LF benchmark and consistently transfers across these downstream evaluations. The enantiomer analysis further shows that three-dimensional molecular representations distinguish mirror-image molecules in a way that two-dimensional graph models fundamentally cannot, although accurately predicting the perceptual consequences of stereochemistry remains an open challenge. Together, these results support a train-once, transfer-across-tasks paradigm for machine olfaction and suggest that chemically pretrained molecular representations provide a strong foundation for transferable olfactory prediction.
items.summary_zh: 研究将 Uni-Mol2 在 GS-LF 气味描述符任务上微调后，直接迁移到跨数据集预测、气味/无气味分类、对映体评估和混合物可分辨性四类机器嗅觉任务，报告达到或超过专用基线。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 该结果支持用化学预训练的三维表征服务多类嗅觉任务，并特别显示其可区分镜像分子。感知后果的立体化学预测仍未解决，迁移测试的范围也尚不足以代表真实配方和人类嗅觉的全部复杂性。
items.abstract_zh: 基础模型已经改变了分子性质预测，但一个在单一规范嗅觉预测任务上微调的分子基础模型能否学习到可迁移至多种机器嗅觉问题的表征，仍不清楚。我们通过在 GS-LF 基准上微调 Uni-Mol2 进行多标签气味描述符预测，并在不进行额外深度学习训练的情况下，将所得模型评估于四种互补的下游场景：跨数据集气味描述符预测、有气味与无气味分类、对映体评估以及气味混合物可分辨性。该微调模型在主要 GS-LF 基准上达到或超过最先进的嗅觉专用基线性能，并在这些下游评估中表现出一致的迁移能力。对映体分析进一步显示，三维分子表征能够以二维图模型从根本上无法做到的方式区分镜像分子，尽管准确预测立体化学的感知后果仍是一项开放挑战。总体而言，这些结果支持“训练一次、跨任务迁移”的机器嗅觉范式，并表明经化学预训练的分子表征为可迁移嗅觉预测提供了坚实基础。
items.author_line: Yikun Han, Yi Wang, Neil Mankodi, Stephen Yang, Ambuj Tewari

items.title: Beyond Multiscale: A Neural Network-Unified Molecular Model for Asymmetry-Free Dynamics Simulation
items.abstract_or_text: Adaptive multiscale simulations, such as adaptive QM/MM, are indispensable for investigating complex solution dynamics but historically suffer from a fundamental dilemma: the dynamic exchange of identical solvent molecules across different model resolutions introduces an energetic asymmetry under solvent exchange (specifically, a permutation asymmetry where physically identical molecules are treated indistinguishably yet subjected to different force fields depending on their instantaneous positions). This asymmetry forces a prohibitive trade-off between severe structural distortions and the violation of Hamiltonian conservation (continuous energy drift). To resolve this issue, we propose the ”Integrated Molecular Model,” a paradigm-shifting framework that unifies multiple resolutions into a single, dynamically consistent potential. By employing a neural network that takes only the multiscale weight functions as input descriptors, our model learns to systematically cancel the non-physical transition forces originating from spatial discontinuities. As a proof-of-concept, we validated this unified framework on bulk water, aqueous ionic solutions, and reactive hydronium ions. Our approach not only faithfully restores artifact-free solvation structures but also strictly conserves the Hamiltonian, enabling unprecedentedly stable, long-term simulations under the microcanonical (NVE) ensemble. Consequently, the model successfully eliminates artificial thermostat-induced breathing modes, allowing for the rigorous evaluation of intrinsic dynamical properties such as diffusion coefficients. Furthermore, owing to its physically informed network design, the correction potential introduces less than 2% additional computational overhead and demonstrates remarkable zero-shot transferability across chemically similar ionic species. By eradicating the inherent asymmetry of adaptive multiscale modeling, this highly scalable framework establishes a robust foundation for high-fidelity simulations of complex condensed-phase phenomena, including reactive dynamics at solid-liquid interfaces and ion transport in battery electrolytes.
items.summary_zh: 该研究提出由神经网络学习校正势的 Integrated Molecular Model，将自适应 QM/MM 等多分辨率模型统一到动态一致的势能框架中，并在水、离子溶液和水合氢离子上测试结构、能量守恒和迁移能力。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 方法针对自适应多尺度模拟中溶剂交换引起的结构伪影和能量漂移，报告不足 2% 的额外计算开销及相近离子间的零样本迁移。当前验证仍集中于相对简单的液相体系，固–液界面和电池电解质等目标场景尚待直接验证。
items.abstract_zh: 自适应多尺度模拟，例如自适应 QM/MM，对于研究复杂溶液动力学不可或缺，但历来面临一个根本困境：相同溶剂分子在不同模型分辨率之间的动态交换会在溶剂交换时引入能量不对称性，具体而言，是一种置换不对称性，即物理上相同的分子虽被不可区分地对待，却会因瞬时位置不同而受到不同力场作用。这种不对称性迫使研究者在严重结构畸变与违反哈密顿量守恒（持续能量漂移）之间作出高昂取舍。为解决这一问题，我们提出“Integrated Molecular Model”，一种将多种分辨率统一为单一、动力学一致势能的全新框架。该模型采用仅以多尺度权重函数为输入描述符的神经网络，学习系统消除由空间不连续性产生的非物理过渡力。作为概念验证，我们在体相水、水溶离子体系和反应性水合氢离子上验证了这一统一框架。我们的方法既能忠实恢复无伪影的溶剂化结构，又能严格守恒哈密顿量，从而在微正则（NVE）系综下实现前所未有的稳定长时间模拟。因此，该模型成功消除了人工恒温器诱导的呼吸模态，可对扩散系数等内禀动力学性质进行严格评估。此外，由于网络设计融入物理信息，校正势仅增加不到 2% 的计算开销，并在化学性质相近的离子物种之间表现出显著的零样本迁移能力。通过消除自适应多尺度建模固有的不对称性，这一高可扩展框架为复杂凝聚相现象的高保真模拟奠定了稳健基础，包括固–液界面的反应动力学和电池电解质中的离子输运。
items.author_line: Takuma Ikeda, Hiroshi C. Watanabe, Haruyuki Nakano

items.title: Insights into Lithium Diffusion in Crystalline and Amorphous Solid Electrolytes with Machine Learning Interatomic Potentials
items.abstract_or_text: Amorphization is a widely used approach to tune the ionic conductivity in solid electrolytes, but its effect in different anion chemistries remains poorly understood. In this work, we employ molecular dynamics (MD) simulations with machine learning interatomic potentials (MLIPs) to quantify the effects of amorphization on Li-ion transport in lithium solid electrolytes from three anion chemistries: Li3YCl6 (LYC), Li0.33La0.56TiO3 (LLTO) and Li7P3S11 (LPS). With amorphization, it is observed that the ionic conductivity increases for LYC, decreases for LLTO and remains relatively unchanged for LPS, in agreement with previous experiments. Coordination analysis at 300K reveals that these ionic conductivity changes can be correlated with amorphization-induced changes in Li-anion coordination environments; decreases in coordination increase ionic conductivity and vice versa. These different responses show that the effect of amorphization on Li-ion diffusion behavior is not universal and is governed by specific anion coordination motifs.
items.summary_zh: 研究以机器学习原子间势驱动分子动力学，比较 Li3YCl6、Li0.33La0.56TiO3 与 Li7P3S11 非晶化前后的 Li 离子输运，并将电导变化关联到 Li–阴离子配位环境。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 结果显示非晶化对离子输运的影响取决于阴离子化学而非普遍增益，并与既有实验趋势一致，可为固态电解质结构调控提供机制线索。摘要未给出势函数训练集和误差细节，定量结论仍应结合更广泛的实验体系审视。
items.abstract_zh: 非晶化是调节固态电解质离子电导率的常用方法，但其在不同阴离子化学体系中的影响仍缺乏认识。本文采用结合机器学习原子间势（MLIPs）的分子动力学（MD）模拟，量化非晶化对三种阴离子化学体系中锂固态电解质 Li 离子输运的影响：Li3YCl6（LYC）、Li0.33La0.56TiO3（LLTO）和 Li7P3S11（LPS）。非晶化后，LYC 的离子电导率升高，LLTO 的离子电导率降低，而 LPS 相对保持不变，这与既有实验结果一致。在 300K 下的配位分析显示，这些离子电导率变化可与非晶化诱导的 Li–阴离子配位环境变化相关联；配位数降低会提高离子电导率，反之亦然。这些不同响应表明，非晶化对 Li 离子扩散行为的影响并不具有普适性，而是由特定阴离子配位基元决定。
items.author_line: Adesh Rohan Mishra, Ji Qi, Shyue Ping Ong

items.title: Realistic Simulations of Energy Materials Using Foundation Models and Electrode-Potential Learning
items.abstract_or_text: Here, we evaluate SevenNet-Omni [Kim et al., Nat. Commun. 2026, 17, 3432], a universal machine-learning interatomic potential (MLIP), in realistic energy-material systems whose long timescale simulations are beyond the practical reach of density-functional theory (DFT). Tests span explicit solvation, metal-support interfaces, and reactive battery surfaces and interfaces, all of which involve realistic cross-domain interactions between inorganic materials and organic species. Without system-specific fine-tuning, SevenNet-Omni achieves sufficient accuracy for these out-of-domain systems, demonstrating strong transferability. To extend MLIPs to electrochemical systems, we also develop a model that predicts work-function changes across surface configurations. The model achieves errors of approximately 0.1 V, suggesting the usefulness of the approach for simulating energy systems under applied electrode bias potentials. Together, these results highlight the potential of foundation MLIPs for simulating next-generation energy systems.
items.summary_zh: 作者评估通用机器学习原子间势 SevenNet-Omni 在显式溶剂、金属–载体界面和反应性电池界面中的迁移性，并建立预测表面构型功函数变化的模型以处理外加电极偏压。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 研究将基础势模型推进到 DFT 难以覆盖的长时间能量材料模拟，并报告约 0.1 V 的功函数变化误差，面向电化学界面具有潜在用途。准确性结论依赖所列测试体系，缺少系统特异微调时对更复杂反应和长时间尺度的稳定性仍需进一步核实。
items.abstract_zh: 本文评估了通用机器学习原子间势（MLIP）SevenNet-Omni [Kim et al., Nat. Commun. 2026, 17, 3432] 在真实能量材料体系中的表现；这些体系的长时间尺度模拟在实际操作中超出密度泛函理论（DFT）的可及范围。测试涵盖显式溶剂化、金属–载体界面以及反应性电池表面和界面，均涉及无机材料与有机物种之间真实的跨领域相互作用。无需体系特异微调，SevenNet-Omni 即可在这些分布外体系中达到足够精度，显示出很强的迁移性。为将 MLIP 扩展至电化学体系，我们还开发了一个预测不同表面构型间功函数变化的模型。该模型误差约为 0.1 V，表明这种方法可用于模拟施加电极偏压下的能量体系。总体而言，这些结果凸显了基础 MLIP 在模拟下一代能源体系中的潜力。
items.author_line: Jinwoong Chae, Hyeseung Kim, I, Hyun-Jae Lee, Sojeong Yang, Yang-Jun Lee, Jungwoo Choi, Byung Chul Yeo, Donghun Kim, Ho-Il Ji, Sang Soo Han, Byungju Lee, Stefan Ringe, Sungwoo Kang

items.title: Text Embedding-Assisted Prediction of Corrosion Inhibition Efficiency Using Machine Learning under Small-Sample Conditions
items.abstract_or_text: Machine learning has been increasingly applied to corrosion prediction, but limited experimental data remain a challenge for small-sample prediction. This study investigates how text embedding can be used as a molecular representation for predicting the corrosion inhibition efficiency of organic inhibitors for ZE41 magnesium alloy. An experimental dataset containing 75 inhibitors was used, with 60 samples for training and 15 samples for testing. Conventional molecular descriptors were combined with text embeddings generated using ChemBERTa and Qwen-text-embedding-v4, and five feature construction strategies were compared to examine the effects of embedding dimensionality and feature integration. Direct incorporation of high-dimensional ChemBERTa embeddings provided limited improvement, whereas dimensionality reduction improved the prediction performance. A selective hybrid strategy was further investigated, in which selected descriptors were incorporated into the text embedding while other descriptors were retained in their original numerical form. This strategy achieved a coefficient of determination of 0.61 and a Pearson correlation coefficient of 0.79, compared to those of 0.12 and 0.43, respectively, for the conventional descriptor-based representation. The results suggest that text embedding may be more useful as a complementary representation to conventional molecular descriptors than as a direct replacement, when experimental data are limited.
items.summary_zh: 研究在包含 75 种 ZE41 镁合金有机缓蚀剂的实验数据集上，比较 ChemBERTa 和 Qwen-text-embedding-v4 文本嵌入与传统描述符的组合策略；选择性混合表示在测试集上给出 R²=0.61、Pearson r=0.79。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 该工作为小样本化学预测提供了嵌入与传统描述符协同使用的实证案例，且明确显示直接使用高维嵌入并不稳定。样本量仅 75，训练/测试划分较小，性能与泛化能力对化学空间划分和外部数据仍可能敏感。
items.abstract_zh: 机器学习已日益用于腐蚀预测，但有限的实验数据仍是小样本预测的一项挑战。本研究考察如何将文本嵌入作为分子表征，用于预测 ZE41 镁合金有机缓蚀剂的缓蚀效率。研究使用了含 75 种缓蚀剂的实验数据集，其中 60 个样本用于训练，15 个样本用于测试。将传统分子描述符与由 ChemBERTa 和 Qwen-text-embedding-v4 生成的文本嵌入相结合，并比较五种特征构建策略，以考察嵌入维度和特征整合的影响。直接纳入高维 ChemBERTa 嵌入带来的改进有限，而降维提高了预测性能。进一步研究了一种选择性混合策略：将选定描述符纳入文本嵌入，同时将其他描述符保留为原始数值形式。与仅使用传统描述符表征得到的决定系数 0.12 和 Pearson 相关系数 0.43 相比，该策略取得 0.61 的决定系数和 0.79 的 Pearson 相关系数。结果表明，在实验数据有限时，文本嵌入作为传统分子描述符的补充表征可能比直接替代传统描述符更有价值。
items.author_line: Junpeng Liu, Zhongheng Fu, Wei Wang, Wenkai Cao, Weihua Li

items.title: Rescuable Stagnation: A Diagnostic for Benchmark Suitability in LLM-Guided Materials Optimization
items.abstract_or_text: Large language models (LLMs) are increasingly incorporated into closed-loop materials optimization, yet existing benchmarks provide little controlled evidence of what they contribute once Bayesian optimization stalls. We introduce a benchmark qualification criterion for rescue experiments—which we term rescuable stagnation—for determining, before the optimization comparison is run, whether a benchmark stalls while meaningful improvement remains available. Benchmarks that fail this test make it difficult to distinguish ineffective rescue strategies from saturated or non-stalling optimization. Qualifying a benchmark in advance therefore reduces the risk that null results reflect benchmark design rather than the method under evaluation. We demonstrate the approach on a benchmark constructed from Materials Project shear-modulus data, on which LLM-guided rescue gives no statistically significant improvement over heuristic injection—including a heuristic control provided with the same search information. The LLM nonetheless steers the search toward chemically distinct, high-modulus regions that conventional heuristics do not reach. This exploration behavior reproduces across two model capability levels and does not depend on the coherence of the model’s rationales, though it carries a substantially higher per-proposal cost. The LLM’s distinctive contribution on this benchmark is therefore in where it places exploration rather than in the optimization outcome it achieves, though this distinctiveness did not translate into a measurable advantage under the budget tested. More broadly, conclusions about LLM-guided discovery hinge on benchmark suitability—which qualifying the benchmark makes testable before experiments begin.
items.summary_zh: 该研究提出“可救援停滞”准则，用于在比较 LLM 引导材料优化前判断基准是否已停滞但仍有可获得改进；在 Materials Project 剪切模量基准上，LLM 改变了探索区域，却未在给定预算下显著优于同信息量启发式方法。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 它避免将基准饱和或未停滞误判为 LLM 方法无效，并以阴性结果刻画 LLM 的实际贡献，对材料发现评估设计很有启发性。结论基于单一构建基准和测试预算，尚不能外推至全部闭环实验场景。
items.abstract_zh: 大语言模型（LLMs）正日益被纳入闭环材料优化，但现有基准几乎没有提供受控证据来说明贝叶斯优化停滞后它们能作出何种贡献。我们引入一项用于救援实验的基准资格判据，称为“可救援停滞”，用于在运行优化比较之前确定一个基准是否会停滞，同时仍保留有意义的改进空间。未通过这一检验的基准会使人难以区分无效的救援策略与已经饱和或尚未停滞的优化。因而，预先确认基准资格可降低将零结果归因于方法而实际源于基准设计的风险。我们在一个由 Materials Project 剪切模量数据构建的基准上展示该方法；在该基准中，LLM 引导的救援相对于启发式注入未带来统计显著改进，其中启发式对照获得了相同的搜索信息。尽管如此，LLM 仍将搜索引向常规启发式方法无法到达、在化学上不同的高模量区域。这种探索行为在两种模型能力水平下均可复现，也不依赖模型论证的连贯性，尽管其每个提案的成本显著更高。因此，在该基准上，LLM 的独特贡献在于其布置探索的位置，而非其实现的优化结果；但在所测试预算下，这种独特性并未转化为可测量优势。更广泛地说，关于 LLM 引导发现的结论取决于基准是否合适，而该资格判据使其能够在实验开始前得到检验。

items.title: Interpreting Protein Language Model Embeddings via Orthogonal Projection for Protein Fitness Prediction
items.abstract_or_text: Recently, there has been a growing adoption of protein language models (PLMs) in biomedical science. Their embeddings provide a rich numerical representation of protein sequences which achieve state-of-the-art performance on several downstream tasks including protein fitness prediction. However, PLM embeddings are not directly interpretable and, thereby, it remains unclear what features they encode. To gain insight into which biochemical properties of the protein are driving the prediction, we leverage an orthogonal projection technique that removes linear effects of known tabular features from embeddings and extend it to high-order and interaction effects. In this way, we remove the effects of interpretable biochemical features from PLM embeddings. In an ablation study, we show that this leads to a decrease in performance for a downstream classifier trained only on the embeddings to predict protein fitness. In an additional evaluation, we find that these biochemical features explain a substantial part of the variance in the predictions of this classifier. Hence, we can show that PLM embeddings encode patterns correlated with biochemical properties and quantify their contribution to predicting protein fitness. This computationally efficient approach is not limited to the features or embeddings considered here and is readily transferable to problem settings beyond protein fitness prediction.
items.summary_zh: 研究通过正交投影从蛋白语言模型嵌入中移除已知可解释生化特征的线性、高阶及交互效应；消融后蛋白适应度预测下降，并量化这些特征对预测方差的解释程度。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 该方法为解释 PLM 嵌入中哪些生化模式支撑蛋白适应度预测提供了计算高效的定量途径，可服务蛋白工程。分析主要揭示相关结构，尚不能单独确立因果机制，且解释范围受所纳入表格特征限制。
items.abstract_zh: 近年来，蛋白语言模型（PLMs）在生物医学科学中的采用日益增加。其嵌入提供了丰富的蛋白序列数值表征，并在包括蛋白适应度预测在内的若干下游任务上取得最先进性能。然而，PLM 嵌入无法直接解释，因此其中编码了何种特征仍不清楚。为了解哪些蛋白生化性质驱动预测，我们利用一种正交投影技术，从嵌入中移除已知表格特征的线性效应，并将该技术扩展至高阶效应和交互效应。借此，我们移除可解释生化特征对 PLM 嵌入的影响。在一项消融研究中，我们显示，当仅用这些嵌入训练下游分类器预测蛋白适应度时，移除这些影响会导致性能下降。在额外评估中，我们发现这些生化特征解释了该分类器预测方差的很大部分。因此，我们能够表明 PLM 嵌入编码了与生化性质相关的模式，并量化它们对蛋白适应度预测的贡献。这种计算高效的方法不局限于本文考虑的特征或嵌入，并可方便地迁移至蛋白适应度之外的问题场景。
items.author_line: Paulo Yanez Sarmiento, Pia Francesca Rissom, Manuel Pfeuffer, Marco Simnacher, Jordan F. Safer, Sumaiya Iqbal, Henrike O. Heyne, Nadja Klein, Bernhard Y. Renard

items.title: External Evaluation of Multi-Agent AI Systems in Drug Discovery: A PRISMA-Informed Scoping Review of the External-Evaluation Gap
items.abstract_or_text: Multi-agent large-language-model (LLM) systems are increasingly proposed for tasks across drug discovery and development. This PRISMA-informed scoping review examines a narrower question than capability surveys: whether reported system performance has been evaluated by investigators independent of the original developers. The review applies an explicit operational definition of multi-agent architecture and maps included systems to one of six stages: target identification, molecular screening, molecular design, lead optimization, delivery formulation, or clinical-trial workflows. Absorption, distribution, metabolism, excretion and toxicity (ADMET) properties appear as an optimization objective within molecular design rather than as a separate stage, because no system in the corpus treats ADMET evaluation as its primary reported task. The curated primary corpus contains 13 unique systems satisfying the strict multi-agent definition. One system (STELLA) has an independent external evaluation, reported by an unaffiliated group through BioML-bench. Three systems (Robin, OriGene, LipoAgent) report author-run empirical validation in biological systems. One system (MT-Mol) reports author-run evaluation on third-party benchmarks. The remaining eight report author-curated computational evaluation only. Six benchmark resources are inventoried separately; four have no located deployment against any system in the corpus, and of the two that do, only one was run by an unaffiliated group. A pre-specified sensitivity analysis shows that the two additional systems with documented independent external evaluation — TrialGPT and Biomni — both fall outside the strict multi-agent boundary, indicating that independent evaluation currently concentrates in single-agent, modular, and general-purpose systems rather than in strict multiagent architectures. The review provides a transparent taxonomy, an explicit classification protocol with a stated precedence rule, and a versioned evidence ledger.
items.summary_zh: 这项遵循 PRISMA 的范围综述审查药物研发多智能体 LLM 系统是否接受独立团队评估；在 13 个符合严格定义的系统中，仅 STELLA 具有由非关联团队完成的独立外部评估。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 文章以透明分类和版本化证据记录量化了药物发现智能体的验证缺口，可为后续基准和转化研究提供评价参照。它是针对已纳入文献的综述，系统数量有限，结论不等同于直接检验各系统的科学或临床有效性。
items.abstract_zh: 多智能体大语言模型（LLM）系统正越来越多地被用于药物发现和开发中的各类任务。这项遵循 PRISMA 的范围综述考察了一个比能力综述更狭窄的问题：已报告的系统性能是否由原始开发者之外的研究者进行评估。该综述采用多智能体架构的明确操作性定义，并将纳入系统映射到六个阶段之一：靶标识别、分子筛选、分子设计、先导化合物优化、递送制剂或临床试验工作流。吸收、分布、代谢、排泄和毒性（ADMET）性质被作为分子设计中的一个优化目标，而未单列为一个阶段，因为语料库中没有系统将 ADMET 评估作为其主要报告任务。经整理的主要语料库含有 13 个满足严格多智能体定义的独特系统。一个系统（STELLA）具有独立外部评估，由非关联团队通过 BioML-bench 报告。三个系统（Robin、OriGene、LipoAgent）报告了由作者运行的生物体系实证验证。一个系统（MT-Mol）报告了由作者在第三方基准上的评估。其余八个仅报告作者整理的计算评估。另行盘点了六项基准资源；其中四项未找到针对任何系统的部署记录，另两项中仅有一项由非关联团队运行。预先设定的敏感性分析显示，另外两个具有独立外部评估记录的系统——TrialGPT 和 Biomni——均不属于严格多智能体定义范围，这表明独立评估目前集中于单智能体、模块化和通用系统，而非严格多智能体架构。该综述提供了透明分类法、具有既定优先规则的明确分类流程以及版本化证据记录。

items.title: Large Language Models for Molecular Science: A Survey on Representation and Cognition
items.abstract_or_text: The integration of Large Language Models (LLMs) into the natural sciences marks a shift from specialized discriminative models to generalist generative agents. However, adapting LLMs to chemistry presents a core challenge: the mismatch between the linear, ambiguous nature of natural language and the discrete, topological, and physical nature of molecules. This review provides a systematic framework for bridging this gap, organizing recent advances through the dual lenses of representation alignment and cognitive mechanism. First, we examine how molecular modalities are adapted to the transformer architecture, progressing from Linguistic Linearization, which optimizes symbolic grammars such as SMILES and SELFIES, to Topological Perception, which injects graph inductive biases through adapters and projectors, and finally to Geometric Grounding, which encodes 3D physical reality and equivariance. Second, we analyze how LLMs acquire and deploy chemical knowledge through three complementary pathways: Internalization, which cultivates parametric intuition through pre-training and alignment; Externalization, which anchors generation to physical reality via retrieval and tool orchestration; and Reasoning, which we further decompose into four strategies spanning contextual analogy, sequential deduction, strategic planning, and introspective refinement. Building on this dual-lens framework, we map downstream capabilities onto a four-level task hierarchy spanning Semantic Translation, Predictive Inference, Constrained Generation, and Autonomous Discovery, and we identify three coupled challenges at the representation-cognition interface, outlining a research roadmap toward chemically grounded AI systems.
items.summary_zh: 该综述以表征对齐和认知机制为主线，梳理 LLM 如何处理 SMILES、SELFIES、图拓扑和三维几何信息，并将化学能力组织为语义翻译、预测推断、受约束生成与自主发现四级任务。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 文章为化学 LLM 的输入表征、工具协同和推理研究提供了结构化图景，并明确指出语言与分子物理属性之间的核心张力。其价值主要在于综述和研究议程，未提供独立模型性能或实验发现证据。
items.abstract_zh: 大语言模型（LLMs）融入自然科学，标志着从专用判别模型向通用生成式智能体的转变。然而，使 LLM 适应化学面临一项核心挑战：自然语言的线性和歧义性，与分子的离散性、拓扑性和物理性之间存在不匹配。这篇综述提供了一个弥合该差距的系统框架，通过表征对齐和认知机制这两个视角组织近期进展。首先，我们考察分子模态如何适配 Transformer 架构：从优化 SMILES 和 SELFIES 等符号语法的语言线性化，到通过适配器和投影器注入图归纳偏置的拓扑感知，最后到编码三维物理现实和等变性的几何奠基。其次，我们分析 LLM 如何通过三条互补路径获得并部署化学知识：内化，即通过预训练和对齐培养参数化直觉；外化，即通过检索和工具编排将生成结果系于物理现实；以及推理，后者进一步分解为涵盖情境类比、序列演绎、策略规划和内省式改进的四种策略。在这一双视角框架的基础上，我们将下游能力映射到一个包含语义翻译、预测推断、受约束生成和自主发现的四级任务谱系，并识别出表征–认知交汇处的三个耦合挑战，提出通往化学扎根 AI 系统的研究路线图。
items.author_line: Mingxu Zhang, Yuhan Li, Ying Sun, Dazhong Shen, Hui Xiong

review.note: 在 60 项候选中选出 12 项；均为预印本，判断仅依据题名、摘要与公开元数据。
